concepts.label: Full Admin / Full Administrator (Server RBAC role)

relations.subject: eventing:function
relations.evidence: For the Function Scope or RBAC grouping, we will use the **'bulk.data'**, assuming you have the role of either "Full Admin" or "Eventing Full Admin". For standard or non-privileged users refer to [Eventing Role-Based Access Control](eventing-rbac.md).

relations.subject: eventing:function
relations.evidence: For the Function Scope or RBAC grouping, we will use the **'bulk.data'**, assuming you have the role of either "Full Admin" or "Eventing Full Admin". For standard or non-privileged users refer to [Eventing Role-Based Access Control](eventing-rbac.md).

relations.subject: eventing:control-document
relations.evidence: In the event a Timer created by this Function fires the callback **DocTimerCallback** executes and will write a new document with the same KEY (as the "source" collection) into the "target" collection.

relations.subject: eventing:on-update-handler
relations.evidence: If both "cancel_timer" and "overwrite_timer" are true it is considered an error and no action is taken.

relations.subject: eventing:function
relations.evidence: For the first binding, select "bucket alias", specify **tgt\_col** as the "alias name" of the collection, select **bulk**, **data**, **target** as the associated keyspace, and select "read and write" for the access mode.

relations.subject: eventing:eventing-storage
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused - minted in Capella twin; requoted fresh from this Server page
relations.evidence: The Eventing Storage keyspace, in this case **'rr100.eventing.metadata'**, is for the sole use of the Eventing system, do not add, modify, or delete documents from it.

relations.subject: eventing:function
relations.evidence: If you run a version of Couchbase prior to 7.0 you can just create the buckets **'source'**, **'target'**, and **'metadata'** and run this example.

notable_absence.finding: The cleanup note gives a version-dependent document count for the same operation: 'this will remove the 1280 documents (2048 prior to 7.0.0) for the function from the 'rr100.eventing.metadata' collection'. This is a quantitative, version-gated implementation detail about Eventing's internal metadata footprint that has no analogue in the Capella twin's extraction (Capella has no discrete version number, so a 'prior to 7.0.0' comparison is meaningless there) - a Server-only, on-premise-upgrade-history artifact.

cross_product_finding: As on the sibling data-enrichment page, this page requires the classic Full Admin / Eventing Full Admin cluster-wide role (or a narrower RBAC grouping via Function Scope) and links to eventing-rbac.md - a sentence entirely absent from the Capella twin, which instead lists Test 1/2/3 with no access-control framing at all.
